sectionHints.conversionsQueues: Mizere ya conversion readiness ndi zopempha — fail-closed ngati scope ilibe.

activities.emptyHint: Ma Task, Follow-Up, Call, Email, ndi Meeting amapanga ma Activity.
activities.detailEmptyHint: Wave 1 stub — gwiritsani ntchito ma API a get/status.

tasks.emptyHint: Ma Task amalumikizidwa ku CrmActivity. Osati Support kapena CsTask.

followUps.emptyHint: Ma Follow-Up otsekedwa ndi consent amakhala BLOCKED_BY_CONSENT — osayenda okha.

calls.emptyHint: Konzani kapena lembani ma Call a manual pansi pa CrmActivity. Telephony CONNECTED ndi recording zimakhala NOT_AVAILABLE.

emails.emptyHint: Draft → eligibility → SMTP send-request. Osati Support threads. Accept ≠ delivered.
emails.composeEmptyHint: Gwiritsani POST /api/admin/crm/emails kenako /send. Ma retry ndi idempotent.

meetings.emptyHint: Konzani ma Meeting pansi pa CrmActivity. RSVP ACCEPTED ≠ ATTENDED. Google/Outlook zimakhala NOT_CONNECTED.

demos.emptyHint: Qualify Demo Request kenako convert, kapena pangani Demo. Schedule ifuna Meeting + Calendar. RSVP ≠ attendance.
demos.detailEmptyHint: Wave 1–4 stub — gwiritsani ma API a schedule / delivery / attendance / outcome / handoffs.
demos.agendaEmptyHint: Pangani ma version kudzera /api/admin/crm/demo-agendas; pin ACTIVE ndi POST .../demos/{id}/pin-agenda. ACTIVE ndi immutable.
demos.scriptEmptyHint: Ma script okhala ndi version ndi SoD. RESTRICTED sayiwoneka pa Customer/invitation projections.
demos.contentEmptyHint: Scenario + content packs ndi versioned. Pin ACTIVE; ma pin a Demo amasungidwa.
demos.environmentEmptyHint: Request → approve (SoD) → provision (logical). READY pambuyo pa health. Expiry + DEMO banner. Osati MRA EIS.
demos.checklistEmptyHint: Chitani checklist; lembani rehearsal. Critical fails zimatseka readiness ngati zakonzedwa.
demos.environmentsEmptyHint: Ma Environment a DENV-YYYY-######. Cloud/container provision ndi NOT_AVAILABLE.
demos.dataPacksEmptyHint: Ma pack a synthetic/fixture okha. Production data ndi credentials zimakanidwa.
demos.deliveryEmptyHint: Yambani/malizani session; lembani agenda coverage, nkhani, ndi mafunso. Meeting COMPLETED ≠ DELIVERED.
demos.attendanceEmptyHint: Chitsimikizo chovomerezeka kapena projection ya Meeting attendance. RSVP yokha sichiika ATTENDED.
demos.recordingEmptyHint: Request / consent / approve / deny. Provider NOT_AVAILABLE — palibe mafayilo a recording.
demos.outcomeEmptyHint: Lembani outcome + completeness. Completeness ≠ success. Sipasintha Opportunity yokha.
demos.feedbackFormsEmptyHint: Ma form/response. Scores sizimapangidwa. Feedback siykakamiza outcome.
demos.reportsEmptyHint: KPIs zowona + schedules. Empty ≠ invent zeroes. DEMO_REQUEST sizikhala volume ya Demo.

demoRequests.emptyHint: DEMO_REQUEST / REQUEST_DEMO → DMR. Convert ndi idempotent ndipo sipanga Opportunity.

calendar.emptyHint: Kalendala ya mkati (day/week/month/agenda) + ICS. External sync ndi NOT_CONNECTED.

reminders.emptyHint: Konzani ma Reminder pa ma Activity. Delivery sayimaliza Activity. Dedupe: rule+activity+recipient+occurrence+channel.

templates.emptyHint: Ma template okhala ndi version. ACTIVE sangathe kusinthidwa mwachindunji — tumizani version yatsopano.

rules.emptyHint: Maziko okha: Lead assigned → first-contact Task; stage entry → checklist; no-next-action warning. SoD yofunikira.

activityReports.emptyTitle: Palibe data ya malipoti a activity
activityReports.emptyHint: Ma metric a Activity okhala ndi honesty + schedules. Gate ilephera sipanga zeroes zabodza.

pipeline.emptyHint: Pangani kuchokera ku READY lead handoff. Palibe ma card abodza.
pipeline.boardHint: Kusintha stage kumapita ku server. Ngati zilephera, card imabwezeredwa ndipo missing criteria ziwonetsedwa.
pipeline.weightedDark: Weighted pipeline amounts zikadali zakuda mpaka Phase 16.

opportunities.emptyHint: Pangani kuchokera ku Phase 11 READY handoff. Palibe mizere yabodza.
opportunities.newHint: Imapanga kuchokera ku READY CRM_OPPORTUNITY_HANDOFF. Simapanga Tenant kapena Subscription.
opportunities.closeHint: Closed Won imafuna evidence, win reason, ndi decision date. Simapanga Tenant, Subscription, kapena Invoice.
opportunities.evidenceHint: Contract ref, email id, meeting notes…
opportunities.readinessHint: Handoff payloads zokha — sizipanga Proposal kapena kuchita conversion.

myWork.emptyTitle: Palibe ma lead mu My Work
myWork.emptyHint: Palibe omwe mwapatsidwa panopa. Ownership imagwiritsa ownerAdminId.

leads.emptyHint: Pangani lead kudzera CRM API kapena public capture. Palibe mizere yabodza.
leads.scoreNeverProbability: Score ndi fit score yokhazikika ndi confidence — si probability, conversion chance, kapena expected revenue.
leads.scoreRunHint: Thamangitsani scoring kudzera API, kenako evaluate readiness kuti muwone score version.
leads.scoreInsufficient: Score ndiyosakwanira kapena kulibe — palibe evaluation yomangidwa. Sipanga score version yosakhazikika.
leads.scoreUnavailable: Score model silikupezeka — sangathe kutenga evaluation.
leads.consentHint: Consent sayerekezedwa. UNKNOWN imalepheretsa READY. Konza kudzera consent API.
leads.noNotes: Palibe ma note (restricted notes zimachotsedwa popanda chilolezo).

readiness.title: Opportunity readiness
readiness.noOpportunity: Sipanga Opportunity, Pipeline, kapena Revenue — handoff payload yokha ku Phase 12.

imports.hint: Ikani ma Opportunity row monga JSON. Amafunikira importIdempotencyKey, title, pipelineCode, stageCode. Ma amount amafunikira currency + amountBasis. Palibe success % yopangidwa.
imports.rowsMustBeArray: Ma row ayenera kukhala JSON array

reports.exportHint: Export ya ma lead (JSON/CSV) ndi Pipeline reporting centre. Amafunikira systemAdmin.crm.export / pipeline view. Weighted totals zakuda mpaka Phase 16.
reports.noFalseZero: ma KPI a nambala aletsedwa (palibe false zeroes)
reports.emptyEnvelope: Empty / unavailable envelope — ma count sapangidwa monga zeroes.

stubs.accountsHint: Ma API a account alipo; UI yathunthu yachedwa. Palibe ma KPI abodza.
stubs.contactsHint: Ma API a contact alipo; UI yathunthu yachedwa.
stubs.duplicatesHint: Gwiritsani ntchito duplicates + merge APIs. SoD yofunika — requester ≠ approver.
stubs.importsHint: Gwiritsani import surface — idempotent preview/confirm. Palibe ma metric abodza.
stubs.settingsHint: Ma definition a catalogue ndi ma version mu code/APIs mu gawo ili.

placeholder.noFakeData: Palibe ma metric ochita sample a production.
